title: Talked About As...
grammar: -ként for a role compared with mint for a comparison
goal: I can tell -ként (a role) from mint (a comparison).
I can say in what role someone acts, with words like állampolgárként and önkéntesként.
I can talk about society with four new words, such as életszínvonal and szegénységi küszöb.
I can say that citizens are responsible for their community.
